title: A ROUTE TABLE -- how this host routes a task, on two axes, and which proofs it may run
description: ADR-022 decision 3. Routing is chosen on two facts a packet states -- how much unmade judgement it holds, and what a wrong answer costs to undo -- and the ANSWER in each cell is the host's: two teams route differently and both are right, so the kit ships the grammar and nothing in any cell. A cell may name the role it is routed to, the adapter, whether a verification profile is required, a budget ceiling and a packet ceiling. A profile is a NAMED argv run in the worker's tree on return -- the only thing the port will ever execute on a task's behalf. No cell declared is the declared zero: packets are carried and nothing is judged by their routing facts, which the port says.

role.description: The role a task in this cell is dispatched as.

adapter.description: The adapter a task in this cell is routed to.

ceiling_chars.description: The longest instruction a packet in this cell may carry: an inlined wall is re-billed on every call of the run.

task_class.description: The class of work this cell routes, from the declared task-class vocabulary (`task-classes`): mechanical work is a verb or a script and is never dispatched to a model.

actor.description: Who carries out work in this cell: `script` (a verb or a script -- zero tokens), `model`, or `human` (an owner's door). Only `model` is dispatched.

model.description: The model a worker in this cell runs on, in the product's own spelling -- declared here, never hardcoded in a kit or an adapter. The cheapest that keeps quality.

effort.description: The reasoning effort, in the product's own spelling.

budget_usd.description: A hard spend cap per run, where the product can be told one.

max_turns.description: A hard turn cap per run, where the product can be told one.

timeout_s.description: A STOP CONDITION every product honours: the run is ended at this wall time and recorded as failed -- never retried silently.

escalates_to.description: The cell a failed run in this cell is escalated to (a declared signal: the run failed or a gate refused its return). The port records the escalation and starts nothing: the next run is a new decision.
